propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes a concurrent job slot and performs identical test coverage to the matrix-based test jobs, making it redundant.

Removing the import-linter job opens a gap where future edits (marker additions, file moves, path filters) could silently remove the optionality tests from default collection without triggering a failure.
A durable collection guard test must verify that test_core_optionality.py and test_optional.py are always collected by the default suite selection and assert exactly 9 items are found.
The collection guard test must fail if a pytest marker is added to either file that excludes it from the default selection.
Stale job context references in infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json must be removed after the import-linter job deletion to avoid rollback automation failures.
